answer: Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. The reveal must open the same zenith hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the velvet gate. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 56 original texts is the only way to fill 16 aliases; the cedar log preserves both halves. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
